title: Origami — an idea becomes a connected system

scenes.title: The idea folds
scenes.purpose: One terracotta square sheet on a dark cutting mat folds into a kite base: the idea takes shape.
visuals: Terracotta square sheet, diagonal crease visible
Left then right flap valley-fold about crease hinges from the top corner, revealing the darker reverse paper
Stationary slate cutting mat with faint sage grid

beats.development: Flat sheet establishes the single piece of paper.
captions: ONE SHEET · NO CUTS · SEVEN FOLDS

beats.development: Left flap folds (0.15–0.60 s), right flap follows (0.40–0.85 s) and lands on the diagonal.

scenes.title: Pleats connect
scenes.purpose: Accordion pleats extend from under the idea and carry two sage kites outward, then those kites fold.
visuals: Two sage pleated strips extend left and right (XPBD-solved hinge chain, rigid panels)
Centre kite settles as ridges lower

beats.development: Pleats unfold from a compressed stack to a 340-unit span on each side; sage sheets emerge from beneath the terracotta kite.
End sheets fold into kites, left flap then right flap.

scenes.title: System complete
scenes.purpose: Scored crease links reach two small sheets that fold into kites, completing the network; then hold.
visuals: Ivory dashed crease links drawn from the centre outward (start 1.55 s)
Two small sage kites fold sequentially

beats.development: Small kites complete their second flaps (folds began at 1.85 s and 2.0 s).
Settled hold on the complete connected system for reading.

findings: Primary focus moves centre → horizontal ends → diagonals, one development at a time with small overlaps for continuity.
All copy is static and legible for the full 3 s; motion settles by 2.5 s.

notes: Silent preview: no music, effects or voice.
Background is a scene-dependent dark slate cutting mat (#222f32 derived from foreground #304347); no source frames matched, so no source observations were used.
Renderer: Three.js WebGL; motion owner: GSAP timeline time, with XPBD pleat solve cached at fixed step.
